rules: enabled=true only with Ahmet's word in the thread. Client addresses come from the Firestore 'client-contacts' doc (v11_client_watch.py contacts import on the Mac), never from this file or git. mode 'silent_draft': nothing is ever sent. mode 'reply': only brands in reply.brands and mails received after reply.since get a same-thread reply (v11_client_reply); every other mail stays a silent draft. Adding a brand or a client address is Ahmet's GO. shadow_from: agency people whose 'Gölge:' forwards are drafted silently (never sent; the chain skips them). A contact row is auto-send only with direct=true (Markalar 'doğrudan yazabilir mi' = Evet). jobs: client mails of the listed brands that the draft marks job_ready open to-dos in the brand's Basecamp lists (v11_client_job); uploads are scored once each; 90+ goes to the client as an attachment in the same thread, 80-89 waits for an approver's 'uygun', below 80 is a revision request (max_revisions), then the approvers decide.
